items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 31 August 2026 at 9:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred over southeast Scotland tracks eastwards, while high pressure lies to the west of Portugal.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6, decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 this afternoon, becoming West or Southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, becoming South or Southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers develop tomorrow evening, then rain overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers later.
